components.purpose: Page title and one-line intro with no image. Its guidance is a plain section heading with optional subheading and description, no image or buttons, and it is allowed at the top of a page.
The plans as cards: each tier has a name, monthly price, highlights and a CTA button. Its guidance says to use it for plans side by side with a button per plan.
The full comparison grid, with comparison rows entered as content items (feature, values, note). I chose it over PricingTable because PricingTable needs a features JSON structure I don't have.
Billing FAQs. It has a subheading, a heading and a nested list of FAQ items, which fits a question-and-answer block.
